why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: Create an account on the node dashboard . Sign-up shows a 12-word recovery phrase for the node's wallet. Write it down and never share it.
Link your X, Discord and Telegram accounts under Missions and Rewards. OptimAI says of Island runs: "We can't approve a run while they're unlinked".
Open the Router tab in Core Node, click the invite card to get your personal Island link, and open the link in a browser.
Answer the six boxes. The questions are drawn from past quiz events in OptimAI's Discord, so reading those first helps.
If you finish all six, watch the dashboard's notifications for Router early access.
